1× 10 MW klystron
32× TESLA-type 1,3-GHz cavities housed in 4 cryomodules
32× motorized power couplers
32× motorized tuners
64× piezo (actuator actuator / sensor) 25 RF Stations
36× motorized phase shifters (1/ cav + 1/ cryomodule) - 25 Klystrons
100+ LLRF channels (probe, forward, reflected) - 97 Cryomodules
- 776 1.3 GHz cavities
